_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Nyè Agbalẽtɔ {player_id} le Tic Tac Toe me.
Nuwɔwɔ ƒe takpekpe nye be wɔna etɔ̃ etɔ̃ (ƒe ƒuƒo, ƒe gɔme, alo ƒe mɔ̃ɖɔ̃ɖɔ̃) le agbalẽ dzi.
Le nuwɔwɔ ƒe gɔme, ekpɔ wòdzí xexlẽ ƒe nu (0-8) si wòkpɔna be wòawɔ wòƒe ŋkɔ le eme.
Abi, '[4]' wɔa wòƒe ŋkɔ le agbalẽ ƒe gɔme.
Le Agbalẽtɔ {player_id} ƒe ŋkɔ, wòawɔ '{symbol}', eye wòƒe agbalẽtɔ ƒe ŋkɔ nye '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mɔnu si dzi woazã nuŋɔŋlɔa ɖo la mesɔ o.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} menye xɔxɔdɔ o. Ele be wòanɔ 0 kple 8 domee.

game_action.placed: Ŋutsu {player_id} da na ŋkɔsi ({symbol}) le asa {cell}.
